tool.name: Prisma AIRS
tool.description: Palo Alto Networks AI security platform for agent discovery, model scanning, red teaming, posture and runtime protection.
strengths: Runtime security via API or network intercept
AI red teaming and model scanning
tool.statusNote: Prisma AIRS 3.0 announced 2026-03-23; its AI Agent Gateway was in limited preview at launch.
tool.practitionerNote: Best fit for Palo Alto Networks customers who want AI runtime controls in Strata Cloud Manager alongside existing firewalls. It absorbed Protect AI (acquisition closed 2025-07-22) and Portkey's AI gateway (closed 2026-05-29), so expect packaging changes.
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.

dataResidency.detail: API intercept deployment profile selects region (Americas, EU-Germany, India, Singapore, Japan); some features process out of region.

deployment.detail: SaaS API intercept, or network intercept (AI Runtime Firewall) deployed in customer cloud and managed via Strata Cloud Manager.

auditLogging.detail: Logging via Strata Logging Service is referenced in docs navigation but audit-log scope was not verified.

soc2.detail: Palo Alto Networks publishes an organisation-level SOC 2+ report; Prisma AIRS product scope not confirmed.

iso27001.detail: Palo Alto Networks lists ISO certifications organisation-wide; Prisma AIRS scope not confirmed.

iso42001.detail: No Prisma AIRS ISO 42001 certification found on the Palo Alto Networks trust center.

euAiAct.detail: Security tooling for AI systems, not itself a high-risk AI system placed on the market.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary platform tied to the Palo Alto Networks / Strata Cloud Manager ecosystem.
